# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-29 from the 2026-10-29 Hub dump.

- 3,193,059 models tracked, 910,262 declare a base model, 943,310 parent links, 89,830 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
